Latin word

occāsiō

occāsiō, occāsiōnis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

an opportunity, the right moment

In this lexicon

  • occasion

    avoid · classical

  • opportunity

    the recommended word · classical · Publil. Sent. O 31: occāsiō aegrē offertur, facile āmittitur; Liv. 22.39.21: neque occāsiōnī tuae dēsīs; Traupman 92, 269: occāsiōnem nancīscī, take the opportunity

  • possibility

    also used · classical · Cic. Mil. 38: quantae quotiēs occāsiōnēs

Examples

  • Occāsiō aegrē offertur, facile āmittitur.

    An opportunity is hard to come by and easy to lose.Publil. Sent. O 31
